external_source_notes.source: Michelinakis et al., Dissecting Energy Consumption of NB-IoT Devices Empirically, IEEE Internet of Things Journal (2021)
external_source_notes.used: Reported aggregate energy constants for a specified commercial module/operator and operating condition; reference to tables IV, V and VII and PSM discussion in notebook.
external_source_notes.not_included: Original raw measurement traces or full published tables.
external_source_notes.limitation: PSM_W = 10e-6 is a representative rounded value within the reported 9.35-10.61 microwatt range; battery/capacity/sleep assumptions remain model choices. Do not describe every model constant as an exact measured median.
